# 9xenai

> 9xenai is an AI consulting, automation and software company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It helps organisations in Bangladesh, the Middle East and Europe reduce manual work with fixed-scope AI pilots, governed automation and SLA-backed managed services, starting with a 2 to 3 week AI opportunity assessment.

Website: https://9xenai.online/
Contact: 9xenaiii@protonmail.com
Location: Bashundhara R/A, Dhaka-1229, Bangladesh
Languages: English, Bangla

## Facts
- Pilots are fixed-scope and fixed-price; monthly plans start from $500.
- Typical pilot: 4 to 6 weeks after a 2 to 3 week assessment.
- Clients own all code, prompts, configurations and documentation.
- Assistants work in Bangla, Banglish and English.
